rule:
A communal planter box is excluded from Gross Floor Area (GFA) only if it meets every requirement below; otherwise the entire planter box is included in GFA (there is no partial exclusion).

Regulatory text (the authoritative clauses - use them to interpret the requirement and its applicability; you must still work out how to read or measure it from the IFC):
URA GFA Handbook - planter boxes (authority summary):
Communal planter boxes are excluded from GFA if they comply with the following requirements: maximum width of 1.0 m; minimum depth of 500 mm (for planting purposes); to be sufficiently externalised. Planter boxes provided behind full height screening and internalised planter boxes are included as GFA. A planter box that is not within a common or communal area is included as GFA.
Authority definitions: planter box - IfcFurniture USERDEFINED PLANTERBOX; communal use - IfcSpace USERDEFINED AREA_STRATA whose SGPset_SpaceArea_Strata.AST_AreaType contains 'Common' or 'Communal'; communal planter box - any part of the planter box overlaps a communal space in plan; width - the length of the side measured from the edge near the building to the edge away from the building (if the width varies, no width may exceed 1 m); depth - the overall height of the planter box (if the depth varies, no depth may be less than 500 mm); externalised - the sides of the planter box facing out are not obstructed by any building within 20 m. Suggested externalisation check: place 2 layers of 3 points along the building-edge length of the planter's bounding box, at 1100 mm and 1500 mm above the planter surface; project 10 rays outwards from each point for 20 m; the planter is externalised if at least 40% of the rays at each layer are not obstructed by other physical elements.

Label every planter box: PASS when it qualifies for exclusion from GFA, FAIL when it must be included in GFA.
Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcFurniture) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.
notes: GFA-exclusion eligibility of all 8 planter boxes: {'FAIL': 7, 'PASS': 1}. PASS = excluded from GFA. Supersedes planter_box_gfa_deprecated_v1, which gave no criteria.

reference.status: Advisor expert rows; width outcome and communal overlap re-measured from the IFC. Externalisation is not independently re-measured.
reference.policy: The rule states the URA criteria and the authority's IFC definitions; FAIL means the planter must be included in GFA.
reference.limitations: Eight elements only. The advisors' checker disagreed on 1 of 8 (width axis of the L-shaped excluded planter); the measured widest strip there is 1000 mm.
